claims: Paul George was suspended for 25 games without pay by the NBA in January 2026 for violating the NBA/NBPA Anti-Drug Program.
Paul George returned to action for the Philadelphia 76ers on March 25, 2026, after completing his suspension.
George stated he violated the policy by taking an "improper medication" while seeking treatment for a personal mental health issue related to physical struggles with his knee.
The suspension cost George approximately $11.7 million in lost salary, according to reports.
Paul George returned on March 25 against the Chicago Bulls.
George described the time off as a "blessing in disguise" that allowed his body to heal.
George immediately resumed a starting role.
Since returning, George has averaged over 20 points per game, according to multiple reports from early April 2026
